decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits at the core of the firm's water and wastewater pipeline offer, was promoted to its own page, and is cheap to keep given the existing welding and coating capability.
The powder-coated public waste bin is far from the core business, but it uses the firm's existing powder-coating equipment and sells to the same municipal customers, so keeping it costs little.

The waste bin with ashtray line is diversification outside the core, but it shares production with the other street-furniture products and reaches municipal buyers, so it is likely kept for now despite uncertain demand.

The outdoor ashtray line is the most distant from the pipeline business and a niche market, but its low marginal cost on existing coating lines and the overlap with municipal customers make keeping it the more likely choice.
